hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Learn how Cash Pay handles and protects your data while you use our platform services.

document.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
document.description: This policy outlines the general principles governing the handling of data and information associated with the use of Cash Pay services.

privacy-intro.title: Introduction
content: At Cash Pay, we are committed to protecting users' privacy and maintaining the security of their personal data.
This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, and protected when using Cash Pay services.

privacy-data.title: Information We Collect
content: Information necessary to provide services, operate accounts, and properly complete transactions may be collected.
This information may include account details, contact information, and information related to transactions and services used.

privacy-use.title: Use of Information
content: Information is used to provide Cash Pay services, improve the user experience, manage transactions, and communicate about services.
Information may also be used for security purposes, preventing unauthorized use, and complying with applicable legal requirements.

privacy-security.title: Data Protection
content: We take appropriate measures to help protect information from unauthorized access, use, or modification.
However, no electronic method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

privacy-sharing.title: Information Sharing
content: Personal information is only shared when necessary to provide services, operate the platform, or when required or permitted under applicable laws and regulations.

privacy-rights.title: User Rights
content: Users may contact us to inquire about their data or request clarification regarding how their information is used, in accordance with applicable regulations and policies.

privacy-contact.title: Contact Us
content: For any inquiries regarding this Privacy Policy or data protection, users can contact the Cash Pay team through the contact information available on the website.

hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.description: Learn about the rules and conditions governing the use of Cash Pay services.

document.title: Terms & Conditions for Using Cash Pay
document.description: These terms outline the rules governing the use of the platform, services, and transactions available through Cash Pay.

terms-intro.title: Introduction
content: By using Cash Pay services, the user acknowledges that they have read and understood the terms and conditions governing the use of the platform.
These terms govern the relationship between the user and Cash Pay regarding the use of the available services.

terms-account.title: Account & Use
content: The user is required to provide accurate and correct information when creating an account and using the services.
The user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and not sharing them with others.

terms-services.title: Services
content: Cash Pay provides a range of digital services that help users manage their daily payments and transactions.
Available services may vary based on updates, service providers, or operational requirements.

terms-transactions.title: Transactions & Payments
content: The user is responsible for reviewing transaction details before confirming them.
After a transaction is confirmed, cancellation or refund processes may be subject to the terms and procedures applicable to the service used.

terms-prohibited.title: Prohibited Use
content: The use of Cash Pay services in violation of applicable laws, for fraudulent purposes, to misuse the platform, or to harm other users is prohibited.

terms-availability.title: Service Availability
content: We aim to maintain continuous availability of our services; however, some services may be affected by maintenance, technical failures, or circumstances beyond our control.

terms-changes.title: Changes to the Terms
content: These terms may be updated from time to time to reflect the development of services or changes in legal and regulatory requirements.

terms-contact.title: Contact
content: For any inquiries regarding these terms or the use of Cash Pay services, users can contact the support team through the contact information available on the website.
